text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the start of a long and arduous journey in the Twinkle Series for me and my trainee. Her name is…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey, guess who's ready to rumble!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whozza downtown girl ready to throw down?! Starting today, Edo girl Inari is takin' on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: We've got one helluva road in front of us, so I'll be countin' on ya, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: We've got one helluva road in front of us, so I'll be countin' on ya, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The two of us are goin' be the next racing sensation—that Twinkle Series won't know what hit 'em!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
